metadata.description: Partial checklist for remaining properties (Run 4 of iterative process)

checklist.title: Verify STATE-JOB-FAILED returns clean error state with no partial proof data
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate prover job status handling in cli/ code
2. Verify failed job status does not include proof bytes
3. Confirm error response contains only status and error message
4. Check that any partial proof data is not persisted
5. Verify client-side handling ignores any unexpected data on failure status

executable_checks.assertion: Job failure handling returns clean error status

executable_checks.command: Review prover job response serialization on failure
executable_checks.assertion: No partial proof data included in failure responses

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-JOB-FAILED -> Node STATE-JOB-FAILED. This check ensures failed proof generation jobs do not leak partial outputs that could be exploited.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-ADAPTOR-IDLE represents stateless contract ready for requests
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Adaptor contract in contracts/
2. Verify no persistent state affects request routing between calls
3. Confirm each request is processed independently
4. Check no reentrancy state can persist across calls
5. Verify storage layout has no leftover fields from previous operations

executable_checks.assertion: Adaptor contract exists with bridge functions
No uninitialized state variables

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-ADAPTOR-IDLE -> Node STATE-ADAPTOR-IDLE. Ensures Adaptor contract maintains clean state between bridge operations.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ADAPTOR-RECEIVE-UNWRAP-BRIDGE validates user zERC20 balance before proceeding
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate bridge initiation function in Adaptor contract
2. Verify function calls LiquidityManager.unwrap() for balance validation
3. Confirm unwrap is called BEFORE any bridge-specific logic
4. Check that insufficient balance causes revert before any cross-chain message
5. Verify no alternative code paths bypass this validation

executable_checks.assertion: Balance validation via unwrap or direct check exists
Bridge reverts when user has insufficient zERC20 balance

executable_checks.command: Trace control flow from bridge entry to cross-chain call
executable_checks.assertion: Balance validation precedes any irreversible operations

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-ADAPTOR-RECEIVE-UNWRAP-BRIDGE -> Node ACTION-ADAPTOR-RECEIVE-UNWRAP-BRIDGE. Critical validation ensuring users cannot initiate bridge operations without sufficient balance.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ADAPTOR-UNWRAP-VIA-LM delegates to LiquidityManager without bypassing validations
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate unwrap call in Adaptor contract
2. Verify Adaptor calls LiquidityManager.unwrap() directly
3. Confirm no custom unwrap logic that could bypass LM validations
4. Check that all unwrap parameters are forwarded correctly
5. Verify return value handling does not ignore failures

executable_checks.assertion: Direct delegation to LiquidityManager.unwrap()

executable_checks.command: Verify no custom unwrap logic exists in Adaptor
executable_checks.assertion: All unwrap validations inherited from LiquidityManager

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-ADAPTOR-UNWRAP-VIA-LM -> Node ACTION-ADAPTOR-UNWRAP-VIA-LM. Ensures Adaptor leverages LiquidityManager's security properties rather than reimplementing (and potentially breaking) them.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE enforces slippage limits via minAmountOut
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Stargate bridge call in Adaptor
2. Verify minAmountOut parameter is set from user input or computed safely
3. Confirm minAmountOut provides reasonable protection against slippage
4. Check that zero minAmountOut is rejected or defaulted to safe value
5. Verify Stargate call reverts if actual amount < minAmountOut

executable_checks.assertion: Slippage protection parameter exists in Stargate call
Bridge enforces minAmountOut parameter
Slippage limit provides meaningful protection

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE -> Node ACTION-ADAPTOR-BRIDGE-VIA-STARGATE. Ensures bridge operations are protected against sandwich attacks and excessive slippage.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED confirms cross-chain message submitted with delivery tracking
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate event emission for bridge initiation
2. Verify event contains tracking information (tx hash, message ID, etc.)
3. Confirm event only emits after successful Stargate call
4. Check that LayerZero/Stargate message submission is atomic with event
5. Verify refund mechanism is configured in case of delivery failure

executable_checks.assertion: Bridge initiated event exists with tracking data

executable_checks.command: Review Stargate call parameters for refund configuration
executable_checks.assertion: Refund address configured for failed deliveries

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED -> Node STATE-BRIDGE-INITIATED. This property has REACHABLE_PARTIAL status due to cross-chain delivery dependencies. Ensures proper tracking and fallback mechanisms exist.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-BRIDGE-FAILED triggers refund mechanism returning funds to user
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Identify Stargate refund configuration in bridge call
2. Verify refundAddress is set to user address (not contract)
3. Confirm Stargate refund mechanism is properly integrated
4. Check for any custom refund handling if Stargate refund fails
5. Verify no funds can be stuck in Adaptor on bridge failure

executable_checks.assertion: Refund address configured in Stargate parameters

executable_checks.command: Review Stargate SendParam struct for refund configuration
executable_checks.assertion: Refund flows to user on bridge failure
Failed bridge returns funds to user

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-BRIDGE-FAILED -> Node STATE-BRIDGE-FAILED. This property has REACHABLE_RECOVERABLE status - failures can occur but funds must be recoverable. Critical for user fund safety.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-USER-GENERATE-STEALTH uses deterministic Baby JubJub + Poseidon derivation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate stealth address generation code in cli/ or client-common/
2. Verify Baby JubJub scalar multiplication is used correctly
3. Confirm Poseidon hash is applied according to specification
4. Check PoW constraint ensures specific secret format
5. Verify same inputs always produce same stealth address

executable_checks.assertion: Stealth generation uses Baby JubJub + Poseidon
Derivation matches specification: BJJ(secret) + Poseidon(tweak)

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-USER-GENERATE-STEALTH -> Node ACTION-USER-GENERATE-STEALTH. Cryptographic guarantee: Poseidon + Baby JubJub + PoW. Ensures privacy-preserving address derivation is cryptographically sound.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-USER-GENERATE-NOVA-PROOF generates valid IVC only from legitimate transfer history
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Nova proof generation code in cli/
2. Verify Merkle proofs are verified within the circuit
3. Confirm transfer claims must match committed on-chain roots
4. Check that fake transfers fail Merkle verification during proof generation
5. Verify circuit enforces transfer validity constraints

executable_checks.assertion: Nova IVC generation with Merkle verification

executable_checks.command: Review Nova circuit constraints for transfer validation
executable_checks.assertion: Circuit verifies Merkle proofs against committed roots

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-USER-GENERATE-NOVA-PROOF -> Node ACTION-USER-GENERATE-NOVA-PROOF. Cryptographic guarantee: Nova IVC soundness. Core property ensuring users cannot claim non-existent transfers.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-HAS-NOVA-PROOF allows local verification before submission
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate client-side proof verification code
2. Verify local verification API is available to users
3. Confirm verification uses same parameters as on-chain verifier
4. Check that invalid proofs are detectable before submission
5. Verify clear error messages for verification failures

executable_checks.assertion: Local proof verification available
Local verification matches on-chain verification

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-USER-HAS-NOVA-PROOF -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-NOVA-PROOF. This property has REACHABLE_BENIGN status - users can have invalid proofs but this is not a security risk, just UX concern.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-USER-SUBMIT-TO-PROVER transmits IVC proof without revealing private data
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate IVC proof serialization code
2. Verify only public inputs and commitments are transmitted
3. Confirm private witness data stays client-side
4. Check that prover cannot extract transfer amounts or sources
5. Verify ZK property is preserved in transmission format

executable_checks.assertion: Only public data transmitted to prover
No private witness data in serialized proof

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-USER-SUBMIT-TO-PROVER -> Node ACTION-USER-SUBMIT-TO-PROVER. Cryptographic guarantee: ZK property of Nova. Critical for maintaining user privacy when using the prover service.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-HAS-GROTH16-PROOF holds proof compatible with on-chain verifier
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify prover uses same verification key as on-chain verifier
2. Confirm proof encoding matches on-chain expectation
3. Check point coordinates are in correct format (BN254)
4. Verify public inputs ordering matches on-chain verifier
5. Ensure prover completion implies on-chain verifiability

executable_checks.assertion: Same verification key used off-chain and on-chain
Prover-generated proofs verify on-chain

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-USER-HAS-GROTH16-PROOF -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-GROTH16-PROOF. Cryptographic guarantee: Groth16 completeness. Ensures proof format consistency between prover and on-chain verifier.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-USER-SUBMIT-TELEPORT submits proof with correctly matched public inputs
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate teleport submission code in client
2. Verify public inputs are extracted from proof correctly
3. Confirm no transformation corrupts public input ordering
4. Check that mismatched inputs cause clear verification failure
5. Verify client validates inputs before submission to avoid wasted gas

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport submission with public input handling
Mismatched public inputs cause verification failure

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-USER-SUBMIT-TELEPORT -> Node ACTION-USER-SUBMIT-TELEPORT. This property has REACHABLE_USER_ERROR status - users can submit incorrect inputs but this causes failure without fund loss.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-VERIFIER-ROTATE-VERIFIERS requires both admin role and emergency state
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate verifier rotation function in contracts/
2. Verify onlyOwner modifier is present
3. Confirm isEmergency state check is required
4. Check both conditions must pass (AND, not OR)
5. Verify no alternative paths to rotation exist

executable_checks.assertion: Verifier rotation requires owner AND emergency state
Non-owner cannot rotate, non-emergency cannot rotate
No missing access controls on rotation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-ROTATE-VERIFIERS -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-ROTATE-VERIFIERS. Critical access control ensuring verifier configuration cannot be changed arbitrarily.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-VERIFIER-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY requires verifier rotation before deactivation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate emergency deactivation function
2. Verify function checks that verifier addresses have changed
3. Confirm compromised verifier configuration cannot be reactivated
4. Check that deactivation requires new verifier set to be deployed
5. Verify no bypass allows deactivation without rotation

executable_checks.assertion: Emergency deactivation function exists
Cannot deactivate emergency without verifier rotation
Verifier addresses must differ from emergency-triggering config

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-VERIFIER-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-DEACTIVATE-EMERGENCY. Ensures emergency recovery addresses root cause before resuming normal operations.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED guarantees new verifier configuration is active
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Trace all paths to STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED
2. Verify all paths pass through ACTION-VERIFIER-ROTATE-VERIFIERS
3. Confirm new verifier addresses are stored before reaching recovered state
4. Check recovered state clears emergency flag
5. Verify normal operations resume with new configuration

executable_checks.command: Trace state machine from emergency to recovered
executable_checks.assertion: Rotation must precede recovery
Recovery requires complete rotation flow

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED -> Node STATE-EMERGENCY-RECOVERED. Ensures recovery completeness - system only returns to normal after proper remediation.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-REWARD uses immutable incentive parameters
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate IncentiveLib reward calculation
2. Verify k and T parameters are immutable
3. Confirm no setter functions exist for these values
4. Check parameters are set only in constructor
5. Verify no proxy patterns allow parameter modification

executable_checks.assertion: Incentive parameters are immutable with no setters
Parameters that should be constant are marked as such

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-REWARD -> Edge EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-REWARD. Ensures economic parameters cannot be manipulated mid-transaction or by admin.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-LM-PULLS-LIQUIDITY uses safeTransferFrom preventing reentrancy
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate liquidity pull in LiquidityManager.wrap()
2. Verify SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom is used
3. Confirm checks-effects-interactions pattern is followed
4. Check for ReentrancyGuard if needed
5. Verify no callbacks can interrupt between transfer and mint

executable_checks.assertion: SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom used for liquidity pull
No reentrancy vulnerabilities in wrap function
Reentrancy attacks are prevented

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-LM-PULLS-LIQUIDITY -> Edge EDGE-LM-PULLS-LIQUIDITY. Critical for preventing inflation attacks via reentrancy during wrap operations.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-LM-MINTS-ZERC20 mints exact amount + reward with no rounding errors
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate mint call in LiquidityManager.wrap()
2. Verify mint amount = deposited amount + reward
3. Confirm IncentiveLib uses floor rounding for rewards
4. Check for safe math in all calculations
5. Verify no accumulating rounding errors over many transactions

executable_checks.assertion: Mint amount includes exact deposit plus reward
Mint amount matches deposit + calculated reward

executable_checks.command: Review reward calculation for rounding behavior
executable_checks.assertion: Floor rounding ensures protocol never overpays

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-LM-MINTS-ZERC20 -> Edge EDGE-LM-MINTS-ZERC20. Ensures arithmetic precision in minting to maintain supply integrity.

checklist.title: Verify EDGE-WRAP-COMPLETE emits Wrapped event only after all operations succeed
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Wrapped event emission in wrap()
2. Verify event is the final statement before return
3. Confirm any prior failure reverts entire transaction including event
4. Check event parameters match actual state changes
5. Verify no code paths emit event without completing wrap

executable_checks.assertion: Wrapped event defined and emitted at completion

executable_checks.command: Verify Wrapped event is final operation in wrap()
executable_checks.assertion: Event emission follows all state changes
Failed wraps do not emit Wrapped event

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-WRAP-COMPLETE -> Edge EDGE-WRAP-COMPLETE. Ensures event emission is atomic with wrap completion for reliable off-chain tracking.
